name: tint-verify
description: Tint an existing material (custom colour over a catalog texture) renders, and the composer offers a 'Tint a material' group.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: check-optgroup
steps.eval: (function(){var g=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.compose optgroup')).map(function(o){return o.label});if(!g.includes('Tint a material'))throw new Error('no Tint optgroup, got: '+g.join(','));return 'ok:'+g.join(',')})()
